nodes.description: Internal owner address of BotProtected; set to tx.origin in the SimpleToken constructor and used for privileged access checks.
Arbitrary external contract address used as the bot-protection oracle; invoked via low-level call in the checkBots modifier and in distribute/list.
Public address of the generated Uniswap-style pair, derived from the CREATE2 pairForPancake computation.
Public mapping of token balances; written with unchecked arithmetic in transferFrom and overwritten arbitrarily in distribute/list.
Public nested allowance mapping; set to uint(-1) in the constructor and decremented with unchecked arithmetic in transferFrom.
Total supply, initialised to 1e27; used in unchecked arithmetic (totalSupply * 6 / 100) inside list.
Constant token decimals (18).
Public token name string.
Public token symbol string.
Hard-coded Uniswap V2 router address used for addLiquidityETH and pre-approved for the contract's own balance.
Hard-coded WETH/WBNB-like wrapped native token address used to compute the pair address.
External caller address used throughout for authorization checks, allowance spenders and liquidity recipient.
Transaction origin used to set owner and to grant an infinite allowance; classic phishing/access-control weakness.
Block timestamp used to build the Uniswap deadline (block.timestamp + 600), making the operation miner-influenceable.
Modifier that performs an unchecked low-level call into botProtection and requires the returned boolean to be true before executing the guarded body.
Stores the bot-protection address supplied at deployment.
Sets owner = tx.origin, derives the pair address, and grants unlimited allowances to the router and to tx.origin.
Payable external entry point that simply delegates to transferFrom(msg.sender, _to, _value).
Payable token transfer guarded by the checkBots modifier; performs unchecked allowance and balance subtractions and balance additions.
Payable allowance setter that writes allowance[msg.sender][_spender] with no return-value race protection.
Owner-only function that executes an arbitrary delegatecall payload, giving the owner full control over contract storage.
Internal pure function that computes a deterministic CREATE2 pair address from two tokens and a hard-coded init-code hash.
Owner-only function that overwrites arbitrary balances and triggers an external call into botProtection before looping over recipients.
Owner-only payable listing function that rewrites balances, adds liquidity through the router with a timestamp deadline, calls botProtection and distributes balances.
Low-level call to the attacker-controllable botProtection address inside the checkBots modifier; return value is only partially handled and the callee can reenter.
Arbitrary delegatecall to a user-supplied address and calldata executed in the context of SimpleToken.
External low-level call to botProtection before balance writes in distribute; return value is ignored, enabling reentrancy into privileged state changes.
External low-level call to botProtection inside the owner-only list function; return value ignored and callee can reenter before the distribution loop.
External payable call to the Uniswap router with msg.value and a block.timestamp-derived deadline, executed after balances were modified.
Unchecked subtraction of _value from allowance[_from][msg.sender] (Solidity 0.7 has no built-in overflow/underflow checks).
Unchecked subtraction of _value from balanceOf[_from] after an explicit require check.
Unchecked addition of _value to balanceOf[_to]; can overflow without SafeMath protection.
Source address of the transfer, consumed by the checkBots modifier and used as balance/allowance key.
Recipient address of the transfer, passed into the bot-protection call and credited in balanceOf.
Amount transferred, passed to checkBots and used in unchecked allowance/balance arithmetic.
Recipient address forwarded from transfer into transferFrom.
Amount forwarded from transfer into transferFrom.
Spender address whose allowance is being set.
Allowance amount written into the allowance mapping.
Target address of the arbitrary delegatecall.
Arbitrary calldata supplied to the delegatecall target.
Array of recipient addresses forwarded to botProtection and used as balance keys.
Balance value written to every address in _tos.
Amount of tokens assigned to the contract and used as liquidity amounts.
Recipient array forwarded to botProtection and used in the distribution loop.
Array of amounts, must match _tos length, assigned to each recipient balance.
First token address, sorted to compute the pair address.
Second token address, sorted to compute the pair address.
Bot-protection contract address supplied to the BotProtected constructor.
Bot-protection contract address passed up to the BotProtected constructor.
Boolean returned by the low-level botProtection call and used in the require statement.
Raw return bytes of the botProtection call, never decoded or validated.
Success flag returned by the delegatecall and returned to the caller.
Loop counter used to iterate over the recipient arrays in list.
Computed pair address returned by pairForPancake and stored in uniPair.
Lower-ordered token address used in the CREATE2 salt.
Higher-ordered token address used in the CREATE2 salt.

edges.reason: tx.origin is assigned directly as the contract owner, so ownership is bound to an EOA origin that can be spoofed through phishing.
Constructor parameter flows into the SimpleToken constructor argument list.
SimpleToken constructor forwards the bot-protection address to the parent constructor which stores it.
BotProtected constructor argument is written into the botProtection state variable.
BotProtected constructor writes its parameter into the botProtection storage slot.
wrappedBinance address is passed as an argument to the internal pair derivation function.
The pair address computed by pairForPancake is stored into uniPair.
The constructor invokes pairForPancake to derive the pair address.
tx.origin receives an unlimited allowance in the constructor using attacker-influenceable origin state.
The checkBots modifier body executes the low-level call to botProtection.
_from is encoded into the calldata sent to the bot-protection contract.
_to is encoded into the calldata sent to the bot-protection contract.
_value is encoded into the calldata sent to the bot-protection contract.
uniPair is encoded into the bot-protection calldata.
The first return value of the low-level call is decoded into the notABot boolean.
The raw return bytes of the bot-protection call are captured and never validated.
The require on notABot gates execution of the modifier body.
transfer recipient parameter flows into the external transfer function.
transfer amount parameter flows into the external transfer function.
msg.sender is used as the implicit source of the transfer.
transfer delegates all logic to transferFrom.
transferFrom is guarded by the checkBots modifier which performs an external call.
The nested allowance mapping is read and decremented without SafeMath.
balanceOf[_from] is read and subtracted from with unchecked arithmetic.
balanceOf[_to] is read and added to with unchecked arithmetic.
transferFrom executes the unchecked allowance decrement.
transferFrom executes the unchecked sender balance decrement.
transferFrom executes the unchecked recipient balance increment.
transferFrom writes new values into the balanceOf mapping.
msg.sender determines whether the allowance branch is executed in transferFrom.
approve spender parameter is used as the allowance key.
approve value parameter is written into the allowance mapping.
msg.sender is the allowance owner being modified in approve.
approve writes the allowance mapping.
delegate requires msg.sender to equal the owner state variable before executing an arbitrary delegatecall.
msg.sender is compared against owner, and owner is tx.origin, making the privilege check weak.
The delegate target address parameter flows into the raw delegatecall.
The delegate calldata parameter flows into the raw delegatecall.
delegate executes the unchecked delegatecall.
The delegatecall success flag is stored in the local variable and returned.
tokenA is compared and sorted inside pairForPancake.
tokenB is compared and sorted inside pairForPancake.
pairForPancake assigns the derived CREATE2 address to the pair local variable.
The lower token address is stored in the token0 local variable.
The higher token address is stored in the token1 local variable.
distribute gates on msg.sender == owner, and owner is derived from tx.origin.
msg.sender is compared against the tx.origin-derived owner to authorize mass balance rewrites.
The recipient array is used both for the external bot-protection call and for balance assignment.
amount is written directly into every recipient balance.
distribute performs an external low-level call before mutating balances.
The low-level call targets the stored botProtection address.
distribute arbitrarily overwrites entries of the balanceOf mapping.
The loop counter controls iteration of the balance distribution loop.
list requires msg.sender to equal the owner state variable that was set from tx.origin.
msg.sender is checked against owner in the privileged listing function and also receives tokens.
_numList is written into the contract balance and supplied as liquidity amounts.
_tos is forwarded to botProtection and used as the distribution recipient list.
_amounts is indexed to set recipient balances during distribution.
list invokes the external router liquidity call.
The hard-coded router address is the target of the addLiquidityETH call.
block.timestamp plus 600 is used as the deadline, letting miners influence transaction validity.
msg.sender is used as the liquidity recipient and value source of the router call.
list performs an external low-level call into botProtection before its distribution loop.
The low-level call in list targets the botProtection state variable.
list writes into the balanceOf mapping for the contract and for all recipients.
totalSupply is multiplied by 6 and divided by 100 using unchecked arithmetic to compute the owner allocation.
The modifier's external call to attacker-controlled botProtection executes before the guarded transferFrom body, allowing reentrancy into token state.
The botProtection call inside distribute can reenter the owner-only distribute function before balances are updated.
The botProtection call inside list can reenter the privileged listing function while balances are already modified.
The external router call can reenter list after balances for the contract and owner have been rewritten.
An arbitrary delegatecall can reenter the contract and overwrite its own storage slots.

normalization_plan.reason: Parameter _from belongs to transferFrom and is consumed by its checkBots modifier and balance updates.
Parameter _to belongs to transferFrom and is used in the bot-protection call and recipient balance update.
Parameter _value belongs to transferFrom and drives the unchecked allowance and balance arithmetic.
Parameter _to is only forwarded by transfer into its transferFrom call.
Parameter _value is only forwarded by transfer into its transferFrom call.
Parameter _spender is used solely as the allowance key inside approve.
Parameter _value is used solely as the allowance amount inside approve.
Parameter a is the target of the unsafe delegatecall executed by delegate.
Parameter b is the raw calldata of the unsafe delegatecall executed by delegate.
Parameter _tos is used by distribute for both the external call and balance assignment.
Parameter amount is the value written to every recipient balance in distribute.
Parameter _numList is used by list for the contract balance and liquidity amounts.
Parameter _tos is used by list for the bot-protection call and the distribution loop.
Parameter _amounts is indexed by list when assigning recipient balances.
Parameter tokenA is consumed only by the pair derivation function.
Parameter tokenB is consumed only by the pair derivation function.
Constructor parameter _botProtection is stored as a state variable by BotProtected.constructor.
Constructor parameter _botProtection is passed to the parent constructor from SimpleToken.constructor.
Local notABot holds the boolean returned by the unsafe botProtection low-level call.
Local isNotBot holds the unvalidated raw return bytes of the unsafe botProtection call.
Local success is the raw return of the unsafe delegatecall.
Local i is the loop counter of the distribution loop inside list.
Local pair holds the CREATE2 address produced by pairForPancake.
Local token0 is the sorted lower token address used inside pairForPancake.
Local token1 is the sorted higher token address used inside pairForPancake.
